races.name: Stock Exe Building Supplies Mares' "National Hunt" Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bontessony Doll
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to expected pace scenario but 100-1 reflects her unseating debut over hurdles
runners_data.comment: 100-1 and she didn't get very far in a C&D novice (unseated at first) on recent debut
runners_data.spotlight: 100-1 and she didn't get very far in a good-ground C&D novice event (unseated at first) on recent debut.

runners_data.name: Babs
runners_data.note: Natural leader faces pace pressure from multiple angles, 23-day break since disappointing Warwick debut
runners_data.comment: Won a bumper on debut in October but she's not gone on from that; needs improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Won on bumper debut (good) in October but she found things tough in Listed events in next two starts before a well-held fifth hurdling debut at Warwick (2m, good) this month; still early days and should have a future over jumps but she needs improvement.

runners_data.name: Lady Kara
runners_data.note: Fresh off 9-length win but carries 7lbs penalty and faces much stronger pace pressure than at Hereford
runners_data.comment: Off the mark when landing the odds with 9l win at Hereford; big player again under penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt over hurdles when scoring by 9l in a Hereford novice (2m3f, good) two weeks ago; that was at 1-2 in a five-runner race but her main market rival was a clear second and she hit a personal best with that win; big player again under a penalty.

runners_data.name: Whodunit
runners_data.note: Prominent style with fade tendency makes her vulnerable if pace is genuine, 53-day layoff adds uncertainty
runners_data.comment: Down the field in two bumpers this spring and needs a transformation on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Finished down the field in two bumpers this spring, most recently when eighth of 12 here (2m1f, good) last month; wasn't beaten far in that race but she still needs a transformation on this switch to hurdling.

runners_data.name: Princess Of Ballea
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with encouraging bumper form but strong hold tendency could compromise positioning
runners_data.comment: Some encouraging efforts in bumpers but she needs improvement on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Three encouraging efforts in bumpers but she has taken a strong hold at times and her form isn't strong; out of a 2m hurdle winner but she needs plenty of progress on this switch to jumping.

runners_data.name: Lady Litigator
runners_data.note: Leading style suits but mixed bumper form and 45-day break raise consistency questions
runners_data.comment: Newbury bumper winner and she's in the mix on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Mixed results in four bumper runs but she won on Newbury debut (2m, good to soft) in December and was runner-up at Wincanton (1m7f, good) last month; out of an unraced sister to a useful hurdler and she needs a close look on this switch to jumps.

runners_data.name: G Whizz
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with minimal ability, 125-1 Warwick defeat suggests out of her depth in this company
runners_data.comment: Some ability in points and a bumper but was tailed off on hurdling debut at Warwick
runners_data.spotlight: Some ability in points and a bumper but she started her hurdling career with heavy defeat at Warwick (2m, good; 125-1) three weeks ago; opposable.

runners_data.name: Frenati
runners_data.note: Leading tendency but showed adaptability when close second here last time, 53-day gap since that effort
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner and she looks an interesting recruit to hurdling; needs a close look
runners_data.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly; big improvement when winning a Stratford bumper (2m, soft) in March and she took another major step forward when a close second here (2m1f, good) last month; looks interesting now switched to hurdling and she has a good jumps pedigree.

runners_data.name: Amhranai
runners_data.note: Hold-up style fits race shape but three tailed-off bumper efforts suggest fundamental ability concerns
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in three bumpers for two different yards; no appeal on hurdling/stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in three bumpers for two different yards, with latest at Kempton (2m, good) in March; can only be watched on hurdling/stable debut.

runners_data.name: Minnie Belle
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner consistently well-beaten by 40+ lengths in recent hurdle starts
runners_data.comment: Beaten 37l, 52l and 43l in three hurdle runs; no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 37l, 52l and 43l in three hurdle runs and last two have been at Stratford (2m, good) this spring; no appeal.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Litigator, Lady Kara, Babs and Frenati will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all four having prominent/leading tendencies and proven ability. The pace will be testing throughout the 2m1f trip, particularly with Lady Kara coming off a dominant 9-length win and Lady Litigator showing consistent front-running form. With multiple pace angles engaged, the tempo will be genuine and stamina-sapping. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces when the early leaders tire from the demanding pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the four pace angles (Lady Litigator, Lady Kara, Babs, Frenati) engage early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfectly for patient hold-up types to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Bontessony Doll and Princess Of Ballea can exploit their tactical advantage despite the class gap.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lady Kara Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Kara can dictate terms from the front without serious challenge
scenarios.body: Her recent 9-length Hereford win suggests she's found her form, and if allowed an easier lead she can sustain her effort better than the other pace angles. Frenati could track and challenge having shown good form here previously.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Frenati Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If Frenati can sit just off the early pace and avoid the initial battle
scenarios.body: Her close second here last time shows she handles the track, and Twiston-Davies can time a late challenge if the leaders go too fast. The Anthony Honeyball stable has both pace angles which creates tactical options.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Babs Tough Rally
scenarios.trigger: If Babs can settle better than her leading style suggests and show bumper class
scenarios.body: Her Listed experience gives her a class edge, but she'll need to overcome her natural front-running instincts to survive the early pace battle. The 23-day break since Warwick might have freshened her up.

watchPoints.text: Lady Kara and Lady Litigator from the same connections could create tactical complications in a pace-heavy race
Bontessony Doll's 100-1 price reflects her debut unseating but her hold-up style perfectly suits this pace setup
Frenati showed course form when second here and Twiston-Davies may try to settle her off the early speed
Multiple front-runners engaging early will create a genuine test of stamina over this extended 2m1f trip
Princess Of Ballea's strong hold tendency could leave James Reed with positioning problems despite tactical advantage

races.name: Totnes And Bridgetown Races Company Ltd. Novices' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Thickthorn Tom
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with superior rating and Harry Skelton booking, recent Fontwell second shows sharp form with tongue-tie addition, 13-day gap ideal
runners_data.comment: Unexposed chaser who was a clear second off this mark at Fontwell latest; leading claims
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-race maiden but he's been placed in the last two of his three chase runs including when a clear second at Fontwell (2m3f, good; tongue-tie added) 13 days ago; looks interesting off the same mark here and he should have more to offer over fences; leading contender.

runners_data.name: Senor Diaz
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but 13-race maiden pulled up in both chase attempts, 40-day break concerning for struggling yard, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Record of 0-13 and he's been pulled up in both runs over fences; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden who has been pulled up in both runs over fences (2m3f) and was tailed off back over hurdles at Exeter (2m, good) last time; opposable.

runners_data.name: It's A Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from powerful Nicholls yard, fell on chase debut when close up but previous hurdle form suggests ability, tongue-tie retained
runners_data.comment: Fell four out on chase debut at Fontwell but he was close up at the time; dangerous
runners_data.spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles but he was runner-up off 1lb higher at Wincanton (3m) in March; fell four out on chase debut at Fontwell (2m3f, good) last month but he was close up in fourth when he departed; has claims if he can avoid any mishaps this time and he's in the mix for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Getaway Tothe Wood
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 542-day absence, pulled up on chase debut and weak claim jockey booking suggests limited expectations
runners_data.comment: Struggled at massive prices in all five runs and latest was in December 2024; passed over
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled at massive prices in four hurdle runs and same story when pulled up on handicap/chase debut at Leicester (2m4f, soft) in December 2024; on the sidelines since then and can only be watched back from a long absence.

runners_data.name: Ferando
runners_data.comment: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner.

runners_data.name: Roi Du Roume
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent hurdle form at Perth, trainer in good form with 6/34 strike-rate, consistent frame finisher seeking breakthrough
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner who is still lightly raced and he needs a close look on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Irish point winner who is 0-5 over hurdles but he's run respectably to reach the frame in two handicaps at Perth (3m/2m4f, good) this spring; mark hasn't budged but his latest run may have come too soon and he should have a future at this new discipline; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Georges Street
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling over hurdles with poor point form, 5-pound claimer suggests connections lack confidence, hard to fancy
runners_data.comment: Hasn't shown much so far and he needs a transformation on chase debut; first-time blinkers
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in three of his four points and he's been tailed in four runs over hurdles including a Warwick handicap (3m1f, good) this month; has plenty to prove and he needs a transformation on chase debut; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces.

races.paceDynamic: With Ferando withdrawn, this becomes a race without a natural front-runner among the remaining six hold-up horses. Thickthorn Tom or It's A Breeze may reluctantly lead early but neither wants to, creating a crawling pace through the first circuit. The lack of genuine pace-setters means the tempo will be modest until someone forces the issue approaching the home turn. This collapse in early pace strongly favours hold-up horses with a devastating turn of foot who can unleash late kicks in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If no horse takes genuine responsibility for the pace early and they crawl through halfway
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo sets up a cavalry charge from the back with the race becoming a pure stamina test up the hill. Horses like Thickthorn Tom with proven finishing kicks and recent form will thrive in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Thickthorn Forces Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Skelton decides to use Thickthorn Tom's class advantage and dictate from the front
scenarios.body: His superior rating allows him to control the race and kick clear when the pressure mounts. The stronger pace will find out the weaker handicappers and expose those returning from long layoffs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: It's A Breeze Leads
scenarios.trigger: If Paul Nicholls instructs Lorcan Williams to make use of It's A Breeze early rather than risk getting shuffled back
scenarios.body: His hurdle form suggests stamina for the trip but the burden of making the running may prove costly late. This creates opportunities for horses tracking him to pounce when he weakens.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Errors
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses fall or make jumping errors in the testing Newton Abbot fences
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test where experience over fences becomes paramount. Horses with proven chase experience like Thickthorn Tom hold significant advantages over the struggling maidens.

watchPoints.text: Getaway Tothe Wood attempting return after 18-month layoff with trainer having no recent runners - complete unknown quantity
It's A Breeze needs to prove jumping reliability after falling four out on chase debut when travelling well at Fontwell
Thickthorn Tom's early positioning with Harry Skelton aboard will signal whether they plan to force the pace or wait
Senor Diaz has been pulled up in both chase starts and looks completely out of his depth at this level
Roi Du Roume's jumping fluency will determine if recent hurdle form translates to chasing success

races.name: Hugh Michelmore Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Blackjack Magic
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose last win was November 2023 and generally struggles in competitive handicaps, carrying topweight at age 11 with 80 days off.
runners_data.comment: HIs last win was in November 2023 and he's generally struggled since; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Well treated on old form but his last win was in November 2023 and he's generally struggled since then; has something to prove and all of his wins have come on good to soft or slower.

runners_data.name: Snipe
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who has found his niche in hunter chases this year with a good Aintree run, but may struggle to get competitive from the back in a small field.
runners_data.comment: Has done well in hunter chases this year including two wins; respected back in a handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 2-4 since switched to hunter chases in January and he ran well to finish six of 24 in the Foxhunters' at Aintree (2m5f) last month; on career-high mark back in a handicap but he hasn't been far off his best this year and he has won over 3m1f in the past; respected.

runners_data.name: Time To Bite
runners_data.note: Natural leader whose recent Fakenham win confirmed retained ability, but faces tougher opposition off a 4lb higher mark at age 11.
runners_data.comment: Recorded his ninth chase win when making all at Fakenham this month; respected up 4lb
runners_data.spotlight: Admirable veteran who recorded his ninth chase win when making all to score from 2lb out of the weights at Fakenham (3m, good) this month; this is tougher off 4lb higher but he seems as good as ever as an 11yo and three of his wins have come at this track; key player.

runners_data.name: Rickety Bridge
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who impressed on chasing debut at this course, now up 3lb but represents the in-form Paul Nicholls yard with obvious improvement potential.
runners_data.comment: Smooth winner on chase debut over C&D this month and a 3lb rise looks fair; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who was 1-8 over hurdles but he made a smooth transition to chasing when scoring over C&D (good; 13-2) three weeks ago; up 3lb but he travelled well for a long way last time and hit a personal best with that convincing success; interesting contender.

runners_data.name: Moroder
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who returned to form with a good second at Taunton last time, only 1lb higher and proven at this trip with strong stamina reserves.
runners_data.comment: Back to form with a second at Taunton (3m4f) and has claims if he can back that up
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time chase winner who returned to form with a rallying second at Taunton (3m4f, good) last month; only 1lb higher here and has claims if he can build on that back in trip.

races.paceDynamic: Time To Bite will take the lead as the only confirmed front-runner, with Blackjack Magic, Rickety Bridge and Moroder sitting prominent behind him. The veteran will set a sustainable gallop over this staying trip without being pressured early, but the prominently-raced trio will ensure he can't dictate completely. This creates a moderate pace that builds through the race, with the final outcome likely decided by who travels best into the straight rather than early positioning. This race shape favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can benefit from the steady tempo without getting too far back in a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Veteran
scenarios.trigger: If Time To Bite gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old can use his experience to ration his effort perfectly, kicking clear when the challengers come under pressure. His recent Fakenham win showed he retains plenty of ability when getting his own way out front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers press Time To Bite harder than expected
scenarios.body: The sustained pressure will expose Time To Bite's advancing years, allowing the fresher, more lightly-raced Rickety Bridge to capitalise. The Paul Nicholls runner's recent course win suggests he's improving rapidly over fences.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly testing and the leaders tie up
scenarios.body: Snipe's proven stamina reserves and class will tell as he sweeps past tired leaders in the final furlong. His Aintree run showed he handles pressure situations well when allowed to come from behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If Time To Bite goes too slow and it becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The race turns into a test of pure class rather than stamina, suiting whichever horse has retained the most ability. This scenario creates chaos where form lines become less reliable.

watchPoints.text: Time To Bite could get too easy a lead early and become hard to peg back if the prominent racers are too respectful
Rickety Bridge may travel too keenly behind the leader given his inexperience, compromising his finishing kick
Snipe needs the pace to be strong enough to bring his stamina into play from his hold-up position
Blackjack Magic's long absence and advancing years make him vulnerable if the pace quickens significantly
Moroder's jumping will be crucial as any mistakes will be costly in a small, competitive field

races.name: Chris Wills Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Crab Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fading tendencies makes him vulnerable in any finish, plus 33 days off and poor recent form
runners_data.comment: Didn't show much in six runs in Ireland and he needs a transformation for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: 5yo who didn't show much at big prices in five hurdle runs (2m-2m3f) in Ireland; now makes debut for new yard and he needs a transformation on this switch to fast ground.

runners_data.name: Ocean Heights
runners_data.note: Class hold-up horse returning from 282 days off but David Pipe's 4/6 recent record and good going suit
runners_data.comment: Ideally suited by fast ground and he's on workable mark back over hurdles; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper and four-time Flat (1m2f/1m4f) winner who is ideally suited by fast ground; respectable fourth on AW when last seen in February and he's on a workable mark back over hurdles; needs close look for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: St Lukes Chelsea
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed promise at Taunton and gets first-time headgear, could track the leader
runners_data.comment: 0-11 over hurdles but he went close at Taunton on penultimate run; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in six Flat runs and he's 0-11 over hurdles; beaten 11l when fifth at Taunton (2m, good; 15-8 favourite) in March but he went close there on his penultimate run and has claims if he recapture that form.

runners_data.name: Reel Orange
runners_data.note: Progressive prominent mare with excellent Newton Abbot record, recent winner carrying only 5lb penalty
runners_data.comment: Has record of 24121 for Joe Tizzard and both wins have been at Newton Abbot; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive mare who has form figures of 24121 since joining Joe Tizzard and both of those wins have been at Newton Abbot; 5lb higher than for her success over C&D (good) two weeks ago but she still looks feasibly treated and could continue on an upward curve; key player.

runners_data.name: Scoresby
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with momentum after breaking maiden three weeks ago, Harry Ryall having quiet spell though
runners_data.comment: Six-time point winner who won on handicap debut at Fontwell this month; respected up 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time point winner who made it third-time lucky over hurdles when scoring on his handicap debut at Fontwell (2m3f, good) three weeks ago; up 5lb but that was a smooth success and the runner-up has franked that form since; respected.

runners_data.name: Saucats
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with clear fourth last time but inconsistent record makes him hard to trust despite light weight
runners_data.comment: Fair fourth at Taunton last time but he's not easy to predict and is now 1-21
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well to finish a clear fourth in a Taunton handicap (2m, good) last month; has each-way claims if he can back that up but he's not easy to predict and is still a maiden after 21 starts; cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Getone
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on handicap debut but has taken strong hold previously and been well beaten in recent runs
runners_data.comment: Still early days but he needs to settle better and find improvement with a hood added
runners_data.spotlight: 7yo who has been beaten 24l or more in his five starts including three over hurdles; this is more realistic on handicap debut but he's taken a strong hold in his last two starts and he needs improvement with hood added.

runners_data.name: Alberts Bay
runners_data.note: Front runner who should get uncontested lead but limited recent experience over hurdles is a concern
runners_data.comment: Very lightly raced 9yo and he has a lot to prove on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to complete in three of his four Irish points; showed some ability on hurdling debut here (2m5f, heavy) in September 2023 but he's had just two since and has been tailed off in both of them; now goes handicapping but this 9yo has a lot to prove.

runners_data.name: Makinbecon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who hasn't fired in four hurdle attempts despite point-to-point success, Barry Murphy 0/5 recently
runners_data.comment: Low-mileage 6yo but he needs to raise his game back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in two Irish points last spring but he's not made an impact in four hurdle runs including in a Ffos Las handicap (2m4f, good; 20-1) this month; still has low mileage but he needs to raise his game back in trip.

runners_data.name: Blazing Gaden
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse coming off a pulled-up effort and 5lb out of weights, minimal chance on recent form
runners_data.comment: Has struggled in all six runs and he can only be watched from out of the weights
runners_data.spotlight: Has struggled in all of his six runs including when pulled up in a Stratford handicap (2m, good to firm) ten days ago; 5lb out of the weights this time and he can only be watched.

races.paceDynamic: Alberts Bay is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead in the early stages. With most runners adopting hold-up or midfield tactics, the pace is likely to be moderate rather than fierce, allowing Alberts Bay to dictate terms without significant pressure. The lack of prominent runners means the field will be strung out with a clear divide between the leader and the pack sitting off the pace. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can quicken from prominent positions, giving those who can track the leader or sit handy a significant advantage over pure hold-up horses who may face a wall of horses when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Alberts Bay gets an easy lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The front runner builds an unassailable advantage as hold-up horses struggle to close the gap when the pace finally quickens. Prominent runners like Reel Orange and St Lukes Chelsea are best placed to chase home if they can get close enough to the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as horses with finishing kicks can weave through and collar the tiring leader in the final furlong. Scoresby's recent win and Ocean Heights' class give them the edge in this finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Stalker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Reel Orange or St Lukes Chelsea track the leader closely and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The tactical position proves decisive as they avoid the traffic problems facing hold-up horses while having enough in reserve to pass a tiring Alberts Bay. Reel Orange's course form makes her the likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Alberts Bay fails to maintain gallop or something goes wrong with the front runner
scenarios.body: The race becomes a muddling affair that turns into a sprint finish where any of the hold-up horses could emerge from the pack. This chaotic scenario opens the door for an outsider to steal it.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Alberts Bay gets headed early as there's no other natural pace angle and the race could become messy
Watch Ocean Heights for market support given the long absence but David Pipe's horses can be ready first time back
Watch for Reel Orange getting prominent early position as her course record suggests she handles the track well
Watch the start closely as several hold-up horses need to settle and any early keen going could ruin their chances
Watch how Scoresby handles the step up in class after his maiden win as the form needs testing at this level

races.name: Mrs. Pamela Ann Dobbs Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Byzantium
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who ran out when leading last time but his two June wins show he has the class for this level
runners_data.comment: Ran out at the second-last at Wincanton but he was in the lead at the time; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Two hurdle wins last June and latest was over C&D (good); no joy in just three runs since but he was in lead when he ran out and crashed through the rails before the second-last at Wincanton (3m, good) last month; has possibilities if he can maintain his focus this time and he's well handicapped on his best form.

runners_data.name: American Sniper
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with 5lb claimer aboard who should get uncontested lead and ideal tactics for his style
runners_data.comment: Hard to predict but he's on dangerous mark and yard is in good form; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Has patchy profile but he's well handicapped on his Taunton second (2m3f, good) in December and he may have needed his reappearance run at Hereford this month; this step back up in trip is no problem and he's one to keep an eye on for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Ellerton
runners_data.note: Prominent runner fresh off comfortable Newton Abbot win two weeks ago, up 5lb but in good form for Joe Tizzard
runners_data.comment: 2-3 for Joe Tizzard including a clearcut win here 14 days ago; big player back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Made it 2-3 for Joe Tizzard when scoring back from another break at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good; 100-30) two weeks ago; up 5lb but that was a comfortable win from off the pace and this step back up in trip should be fine (first hurdle win was over 2m4f); big player.

runners_data.name: Impecunious
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but stable debut for new trainer Ian Chanin creates uncertainty about immediate impact
runners_data.comment: Two wins last year and he ran well for long way on recent stable debut; could be dangerous
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins for Chris Down last year, with the first at Chepstow (2m3f, good) and latest at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good); well-held fourth of seven on recent stable debut at Worcester (2m5f) but he ran well for a long way and should benefit from that run; could be dangerous if he can get back near best.

runners_data.name: Sam's Amour
runners_data.note: Prominent but struggling badly in recent runs and was pulled up here three weeks ago, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Three hurdle wins in 2024 but she's struggled in last six runs; lots to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Triple hurdle winner (2m2f-2m5f) in 2024 but she's struggled in last six runs and was pulled up here (3m2f) three weeks ago; has plenty to prove and needs a big turnaround back in trip.

runners_data.name: Chillhi
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs very specific pace setup but has shown class in past for previous connections
runners_data.comment: Has struggled for new yard this spring and he needs a major revival
runners_data.spotlight: Flat and dual hurdle winner for James Owen last summer but well beaten in three runs for new stable (Flat/hurdles) this spring; now 4lb lower than for his last success but he needs a major revival; blinkers return and visor is removed.

races.paceDynamic: American Sniper will take the race along from the front with no obvious early pressure from the other five runners who all prefer to sit behind. Byzantium, Ellerton, and Impecunious will track the leader prominently, while Chillhi holds up in rear as his only hope. With American Sniper allowed an uncontested lead over 2m5½f, he can dictate fractions and conserve energy for a sustained kick. This pace scenario strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can travel kindly in behind before making their moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: American Sniper Controls
scenarios.trigger: If American Sniper gets an easy lead and dictates steady fractions throughout
scenarios.body: He can use his tactical advantage to kick clear turning in while the prominent trackers struggle to peg him back over this stamina test. His December Taunton second suggests he's well handicapped when getting these tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Builds
scenarios.trigger: If Byzantium and Ellerton track closer than usual and apply subtle pressure from halfway
scenarios.body: The pace lifts gradually and American Sniper's stamina gets tested, allowing the classier prominent racers to assert late. Ellerton's recent Newton Abbot win shows he handles this tactical scenario well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Chillhi Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays very steady and the field comes home in a bunch
scenarios.body: Chillhi's hold-up style becomes an asset as he can produce a late rattle from the back of a slowly-run race. His dual hurdle wins last summer prove he has the class when getting the right setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If American Sniper goes too slow early and gets swamped by multiple challengers in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any of the prominent racers can win in a photo. Sam's Amour might sneak into contention despite her recent struggles if the pace falls apart completely.

watchPoints.text: American Sniper getting an uncontested lead through the early stages as this makes him very hard to peg back
Byzantium's jumping after running out and crashing through rails in his last completed start
Ellerton's ability to handle the 5lb rise after his comfortable Newton Abbot success
Impecunious on stable debut for new trainer Ian Chanin with different tactical approach possible
Chillhi needing the pace to collapse completely to bring his hold-up style into play

races.name: Racing Foundation Supports Autism In Racing Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Sea Invasion
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent Plumpton form but tendency to race lazily could prove costly over this trip.
runners_data.comment: Won over fences at Plumpton (3m2f) last month; well beaten over hurdles there last night
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdle winner who made it 3-11 over fences when rallying well to score at Plumpton (3m2f, good) last month; however, he raced lazily and was well beaten when back over hurdles at Plumpton last night.

runners_data.name: Supreme Yeats
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer who loves this track and distance, back to form after recent C&D success but carries 6lb penalty.
runners_data.comment: Returned to form with a smooth win over C&D; big player again off 6lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who returned to form when landing a gamble with his smooth success over C&D (good; cheekpieces added) three weeks ago; up 6lb but he beat a clear second last time and he's still unexposed at this sort of trip; big player.

runners_data.name: Renoir
runners_data.note: Struggling since wind surgery and poor over hurdles record makes him hard to trust despite dangerous handicap mark.
runners_data.comment: On dangerous mark but he hasn't fired in two runs this spring and is untried beyond 2m5f
runners_data.spotlight: On dangerous mark but he's 1-11 over hurdles and hasn't really fired since returning after wind surgery this spring; has a bit to prove and he's untried beyond 2m5f.

runners_data.name: Belgarum
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from wind surgery with recent Fontwell win, but this longer trip represents unknown territory.
runners_data.comment: Returned after wind surgery with a win at Fontwell this month; respected back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in his final two runs last year but he returned after wind surgery with a front-running win at Fontwell (2m3f, good; 22-1) this month; this is a different test but he won over fences here (3m2f) last spring and 3lb rise for that last success looks fair; respected.

runners_data.name: Clotilda
runners_data.note: Young mare stepping back up in trip after mixed chase form, wearing tongue-tie and carrying top weight for Nicholls.
runners_data.comment: On dangerous mark back over hurdles and has claims if she copes with this new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler who went close off 1lb lower at Cheltenham (2m1f, good) last April; back over fences in last five starts and she's finished runner-up three times including at Newton Abbot (2m5f) last month; now returns to hurdling at this new trip but she ran respectably over 2m7f on her penultimate run and has possibilities if her stamina holds out; cheekpieces added.

races.paceDynamic: Belgarum will take them along from the front at a steady gallop, with Sea Invasion and Renoir likely to track him in prominent positions early. The pace won't be fierce with only one confirmed leader, allowing Supreme Yeats to settle at the back before his trademark late charge. Over this extended trip, the race will develop into a staying test from the home turn, with Belgarum's early advantage gradually eroded as the better-rated horses close in the final half-mile. This measured pace clearly favours hold-up horses and closers who can time their runs late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Supreme Yeats Kicks Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and Supreme Yeats gets the strong finish he needs.
scenarios.body: The veteran times his run perfectly from the back as others tire, with his recent C&D win proving he's back to his best. His hold-up style is perfectly suited to picking off tired leaders over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Belgarum Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Belgarum's wind surgery has genuinely fixed his stamina issues and he can see out the trip.
scenarios.body: The front-runner builds an unassailable lead as others struggle to close the gap over the extended distance. His recent Fontwell win suggests the wind operation was successful and he can sustain his gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sea Invasion Times It
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Invasion overcomes his lazy tendencies and gets properly motivated by Twiston-Davies.
scenarios.body: The prominent runner strikes at the perfect moment when Belgarum weakens, using his class advantage to see off Supreme Yeats in a driving finish. His recent Plumpton win proves he has the trip and going in his favour.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Clotilda Surprises All
scenarios.trigger: If the young mare's class tells and she adapts better than expected to the extended trip.
scenarios.body: Paul Nicholls' mare uses her hurdle speed to quicken past tired rivals, with her previous Cheltenham placing showing she has the ability. The longer trip actually helps her stamina reserves come into play.

watchPoints.text: Supreme Yeats settles too far back early - if he's more than 20 lengths off the pace at halfway his task becomes much harder.
Belgarum shows any signs of distress or laboured breathing approaching the home turn after his recent wind surgery.
Sea Invasion travels lazily through the race without showing his usual enthusiasm - his motivation levels are crucial.
Renoir jumps with any fluency in the early stages - poor jumping would effectively end his chances.
Clotilda handles the step back up in trip - her recent runs have all been over shorter distances.
